text: 金十数据10月10日讯，9月29日，财政部、中国人民银行等部门发布《关于实施居民购房贷款贴息政策的通知》，明确自今年10月1日起在全国范围内实施居民购房贷款贴息政策，减轻新购买首套住房家庭的商业性个人住房贷款利息负担。截至10月10日，居民购房贷款贴息政策在全国正式实施已满十日。在政策出台后，各家国有大行积极响应，第一时间推动政策落地见效。“十一”假期，全国多个省市顺利落地首批房贷贴息业务，众多符合条件的刚需购房者率先享受政策红利，置业压力得到切实缓解。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — On September 29, the Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China and other departments issued the Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Residents' Home Purchase Loans, specifying that starting October 1 this year, the interest subsidy policy for residents' home purchase loans will be implemented nationwide to ease the interest burden of commercial personal housing loans for families newly purchasing their first home. As of October 10, the policy has been in formal nationwide implementation for ten days. After the policy was introduced, major state-owned banks responded actively and moved swiftly to ensure it took effect. During the National Day holiday, multiple provinces and cities across the country successfully implemented their first batch of mortgage interest subsidy business, with many eligible first-time homebuyers among the first to benefit, effectively easing pressure on housing purchases.
